questions.explanation: The Node class has instance variables element and next, which are the parameters for the constructor. (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: How many instance variables does the Node class have in LinkedStack?
questions.explanation: The Node class has two instance variables, element and next. (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: What does the top method return in a nonempty stack?

options.B: The element at the top of the stack
options.C: The next node of the top element
options.D: The node at the bottom of the stack

questions.explanation: The top method returns the element at the top of the stack, which is self.head.element. (Source Page: [7])

questions.question: What does the top method raise if the stack is empty?
questions.explanation: The top method raises an Empty exception if the stack is empty. (Source Page: [7])

questions.question: How many slots are in a node to streamline memory usage in LinkedStack?
questions.explanation: A node has 2 slots to streamline memory usage. (Source Page: [6])

questions.explanation: The operations in LinkedStack complete in worst-case constant time. (Source Page: [8])

questions.question: What is the purpose of the top method in LinkedStack?

options.A: To return the size of the stack
options.B: To return the element at the top of the stack

questions.question: What does the head variable reference in a nonempty stack of LinkedStack?
questions.explanation: In a nonempty stack, self.head references the top element. (Source Page: [7])

questions.question: What happens when the top element is removed in LinkedStack?

options.A: The head variable is not updated
options.B: The head variable is updated and the next node is set to the top node
options.C: The size of the stack is not updated
options.D: The size of the stack is updated but the head variable is not updated

questions.explanation: When the top element is removed, the head variable is updated and the next node is set to the top node, and the size of the stack is updated. (Source Page: [8])

questions.question: What exception is raised when the stack is empty in the pop method of LinkedStack?
questions.explanation: The pop method raises an Empty exception if the stack is empty. (Source Page: [8])

questions.question: What is the purpose of the pop method in LinkedStack?

options.B: To remove and return the top element
options.C: To return the size of the stack
options.D: To return the element at the top of the stack

questions.question: What does the is_empty method check in LinkedStack?

options.C: If the top element is None
options.D: If the size of the stack is 0

questions.explanation: The is_empty method checks if the stack is empty. (Source Page: [8])

questions.question: What operation is represented by the top method in LinkedStack?
questions.explanation: The top method represents the Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) operation. (Source Page: [7])

options.B: It returns the element at the top of the stack
